author: Claude Opus (claude-opus-5-5[1m]) was the sole designer and visual author. It wrote the geometry and render.py, and generated every SVG and PNG by running 'python render.py'. Codex did not draw, render or patch any visual.

assertions.a_different_from_v1: Yes. v1 has a 36x20 rectangular keep with four corner towers, an axial approach and a rectangular bailey holding two ruin shells. v2 has an 8-sided curtain that follows the rock lip, with towers of varied size at its angles. A diagonal cross wall with an inner gate splits it into two wards. The approach bends to a twin-D gatehouse in the SE face. The residence is an L-shaped range hinged on a single round donjon. Every yard has a job, and none is a ruin. Only these were kept: warm stone/slate/oak, red-and-gold banners and banquet detail.

c_references.inspected: WebFetch of the National Trust page text (layout description). No plan image was accessed.
c_references.learned: a screens passage divides the hall from the service end (kitchen, buttery, pantry); the kitchen is two storeys high with two hearths; private apartments sit at the hall's upper end; a postern gives a secondary entrance

c_references.inspected: WebFetch of the article text. The plan image was not viewed; this is encyclopedic, not the Cadw authority page.
c_references.learned: wards in sequence; a twin D-tower gatehouse with several barriers; domestic buildings set against the inner wall; defences that follow the site, with a water-gate stair down the steep side

assertions.c_inaccessible: No ground-plan image was opened for either site. Both references are used as authoritative layout descriptions only. Two web searches and two fetches were used. A third reference was not pursued.
assertions.d_checks_run: Ran 'python validate.py': ALL CHECKS PASSED on the final run. The checks are: rooms inside the curtain and each room in only one ward; upper rooms carried by ground rooms; 21 doors checked for width >= 2, contact with the boundaries of both linked spaces, and a swing reserve clear of furniture and stairs; stair pairs S1/S2 inside rooms on both floors at the same x,z; 6 routes sampled every 0.2 cells, where each change of space must pass through a door, gate or opening and the route must keep the hero's 0.45 radius clear of furniture. An earlier run caught the barracks bunks blocking door D14; they were moved.
assertions.d_limits: Room shapes are rectangles and circles only. There is no wall-thickness collision, navmesh, camera-occlusion or structural test. The lower ward and the outer approach are checked only at the polygon level. Validation runs on design.json, not on the pixels.

final_reference_and_pixel_check: Opus read references/WORKING_DESIGN_PLAN.md, references/04-castle-downstairs-great-hall.png and references/05-castle-upstairs-map-room.png, then inspected the final castle-v2-overview.png, castle-v2-ground.png and castle-v2-upper.png.
